diagnosticRevisionOnly: Popup scenario instrumentation was added; thresholds, product code and product JSON were not changed. See diagnostic-ui-source-comparison.json.

mainMeasurementUi.view: full map, no selection or popup

stateEvolution: Each group starts from its fixture and advances normally across all three repeats. Cultivation can add workers; per-repeat post-save quantities are reported, not claimed constant.
failedPreflight: Final initial first attempt had screen off and no app Surface. It produced no frame summary and is excluded. Screen was awakened, keyguard dismissed, and USB stay-awake enabled temporarily before main sampling.

longOperation.source: same final APK and process as the heavy main measurements
longOperation.input: ADB actual UI taps/swipes/Android Back, with user-confirmed physical rotation

samplingMethods.frame: SurfaceFlinger actual-present interval, not CPU/GPU duration
samplingMethods.gc: Diagnostic ProfilerRecorder Memory/GC Allocated In Frame; final GC not collected by the available OS path
samplingMethods.thermal: dumpsys thermalservice status and battery temperature

diagnosticUiPreparation: App stopped; saved prior English preference; selected ko in app-owned language.json for controlled comparison; large text and facility status remain on.
diagnosticMiddleReplacement: Repeat 1 interrupted by actual application pause with ADB daemon restart; excluded with raw evidence retained. Valid repeats 2,3,4; quantities continue to evolve normally.
